source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one independent, complex photographic test of the assigned aeolian dune wind structure keyword, use the attached portrait only as an adult appearance reference, and make the environmental structure primary enough for strict pixel review.
subject: One unmistakably adult documentary field traveler at small environmental scale within a complete wind-shaped barchan dune system.
setting: A fog-fed coastal barchan field with a distant dark escarpment at dawn.
event: A crosswind pulse sends loose sand up the windward slope, over the crest, and into a granular avalanche down the lee slipface while the traveler observes with a wind streamer.
visual_priorities: The entire stoss-slope, crest, slipface, ripple, and moving-sand geometry must read as the primary subject.
The adult traveler's general facial appearance, long dark softly waved hair, and natural skin texture should visibly continue the attached appearance reference without implying identity.
The person and field props must remain small and positioned away from the dune evidence.
baseline_prompt_en: A photorealistic 28 mm environmental editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult documentary traveler, whose general facial appearance, long dark softly waved hair, and natural skin texture draw only from the attached appearance reference, standing on a firm interdune flat at the lower left of a coastal barchan field at dawn. The complete dune system dominates the frame: a long gentle windward stoss slope covered in fine transverse ripples rises to a crisp sinuous crest, while a steep lee slipface drops beyond it. A crosswind pulse drives ribbons of saltating sand up the stoss slope, over the crest, and into a small granular avalanche down the slipface. The traveler faces camera in three-quarter view, holding a saffron wind streamer and compact field notebook; her visible face remains unobstructed while her figure occupies about one fifth of the image. Low amber crosslight grazes the ripples, thinning sea fog layers the distant dark escarpment, and airborne grains catch the light. Natural documentary color, wind-realistic fabric and hair motion, deep environmental scale, high spatial legibility.
